layout_note: Use the complete real MaxSAT Evaluation 2024 weighted exact track through dataset_candidate/maxsat2024/. It contains the competition WCNF instances used by the ASE 2025 proof-logging paper (571 instances).
copy_note: The shared package is read-only. Copy .wcnf / .wcnf.xz files into project/ before writing proofs or logs. Use xzcat for .xz instances. Evaluate the complete real 571-instance track.

instance_layout.note: Evaluate the complete real 571-instance competition set. recommended_subset.txt is only a size-sorted listing, not the evaluation protocol.

cpp_environment.note: Prepared automatically by container_setup.sh (g++/cmake/xz + EvalMaxSAT commit 94e677456cab96b2718f6da3f808bf694ac383d6). Upstream EvalMaxSAT does not ship this paper's native proof logger.

python_environment.note: Prepared automatically at container startup with pandas/numpy/sklearn; do not recreate a host .venv inside the shared mount.

not_provided.paper_proof_logger: The ASE 2025 native/DAG proof logger is not vendored; implement it or wrap EvalMaxSAT.
not_provided.scip: SCIP is used in the paper for some intermediate ILP calls and is not preinstalled.
not_provided.certified_cgss: The VeriPB/certified-cgss baseline binary is not bundled; document any comparison you actually run.
